candidates.summary: On a trusted page, an off-site link whose path starts with /u/ renders with no rel and is followed: detectLinkType returns GnoLinkTypeUser on target.IsUser() (line 298) before it compares target.Domain with the page's
candidates.failure_scenario: A trusted realm (/r/gnoland/forum under -trusted-paths=gnoland, LinkPolicy FollowInternalLinks) renders a user post containing [a](https://casino.example/u/promo), [b](//casino.example/u/promo) or [c](http://casino.example/u/promo:ref). weburl.ParseFromURL succeeds with Domain casino.example, IsUser() is true, so the link is typed User, follows(User) is true, Followed is set and rel() returns "": the anchor is <a href="https://casino.example/u/promo"> with no rel, so search engines follow an off-site link from an official page, against the FollowInternalLinks godoc ('follows links within the site and marks the others'). The same link without /u/ renders rel="noopener nofollow ugc". It also wears the in-site user-link icon on every page. The misordering predates the diff (base gave every non-external link no rel), but the diff makes the link type the follow boundary for trusted documents and its sweep of off-site shapes (round 2's //host fix, TestExtLinksPolicyOffSiteWithoutScheme) missed this member of the class. Fix: in detectLinkType return GnoLinkTypeExternal when target.Domain != "" && target.Domain != orig.Domain before the IsUser check, and add https://casino.example/u/promo to TestExtLinksPolicyOffSiteWithoutScheme.

With the domain check moved above IsUser in detectLinkType: TestZZOffsiteUserPath ok, go test ./gno.land/pkg/gnoweb/markdown ./gno.land/pkg/gnoweb both ok; ext_links.go restored after.

candidates.summary: Lead lifts a paragraph that follows a list, a blockquote (even one holding a heading) or a table, while its godoc (lines 38-39) says text after a list or a post someone else wrote never names the page
candidates.failure_scenario:
'# Home

> ## Quoted heading

A paragraph after a quoted heading, long enough to be the summary.' gives that paragraph as the description; '- ## List heading' and a table before the paragraph do the same, because only a top-level KindHeading or KindThematicBreak ends the lead. The lifted description is used on trusted pages only, so the reach is a trusted realm that renders a list or quote of user posts followed by a user paragraph. Fix: also end the lead at a top-level list, blockquote or table, or narrow the godoc.
